note: Reviewed ceiling for F-03 (contract tier coverage). Generated from MEASURED reality by `node scripts/contract-tiers.mjs --write-exceptions`; never hand-typed to hide a tier. Each row names the exact tests it covers, a REAL owner and an expiry; generated rows carry owner:null and are refused as CONTRACT_EXCEPTION_UNOWNED until a human assigns one. A row without tests[] covers every bound test only when its reason says "all bound tests". An entry that is expired, unowned or malformed is RED, not grandfathered.
